verification_summary.method: Per-date comparison with the attachment of the official KSEI notice PENG-0002/DIR/KSEI/0126, cross-checked against the 2026 SKB 3 Menteri list reproduced by ANTARA and RRI and against IDX-calendar reporting by Fortune IDN and Kompas.
verification_summary.note: No date was added or removed. The four SKB entries that fall on weekends (2026-03-21, 2026-03-22, 2026-04-05, 2026-05-31) are not trading days and are intentionally absent; KSEI's notice is limited to closures on weekdays.

verification_sources.role: Official notice PENG-0002/DIR/KSEI/0126 amending PENG-0005/DIR/KSEI/1025 and following BEI Peng-00171/BEI.POP/09-2025; its attachment lists all 22 weekday closures in the same order as this fixture, including the exchange-specific 2026-12-31 'Libur Bursa'. SHA-256 ca444520365cb1d8a74eed4c0e9c72c5718333e9a2745b1002bf6256c454a96e matches the copy recorded in docs/DATA_SPIKE_RESULT.md.

Independent per-date reproduction of SKB 3 Menteri 2026: 17 national holidays and 8 joint-leave days. Matches all 21 fixture dates that are government closures; the four weekend SKB entries are not trading days.
Second independent per-date reproduction of the same SKB 3 Menteri list, used to corroborate ANTARA's date list.
Reports the IDX 2026 bourse-holiday calendar month by month (239 effective trading days), naming 2026-12-31 'Libur Bursa' as an exchange closure in addition to the government dates.
Reports the IDX December 2026 closures explicitly: 2026-12-24 joint leave, 2026-12-25 Christmas, and 2026-12-31 year-end bourse closure.

corroboration_method: All 22 dates were independently re-verified on 2026-10-27. The attachment of official KSEI notice PENG-0002/DIR/KSEI/0126 (amending PENG-0005/DIR/KSEI/1025 and following BEI Peng-00171/BEI.POP/09-2025) lists exactly these 22 weekday closures, in this order, including the exchange-specific 2026-12-31. The 21 government dates also match the 2026 SKB 3 Menteri schedule (17 national holidays plus 8 joint-leave days) as reproduced by ANTARA and RRI; the four SKB entries on weekends are not trading days and are intentionally absent. Fortune IDN and Kompas independently name 2026-12-31 as an IDX closure. Removing the 22 listed closures from the 261 weekdays of 2026 yields the 239 trading days both original sources report. No independent source contradicted a listed date and none named a missing weekday closure.
